answer: The ripple schedule is applied in comet and anchor reveals each instalment. A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4577 identities would post 2500 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
